title: 第15章 毒牙递刀蛤蟆心惊第16章 终入丁帐得名来宝
content_zh:
不仅仅是莫凡，其他妖怪此刻也皆看向了首座上宛如黑旋风的妖王，都想要知道他将会给出怎样的机缘于那蛤蟆。
红袍妖怪等三位将军眼中显露出一丝惊讶，他们也未曾想到今日大王居然会如此大方，想来应该是和之前献上的人族美女有关，或许是正在兴头上。
至于洞中其他小妖们则是对莫凡三妖颇为羡慕，需知他们昔日刚上山时可没这么好的待遇。
“至于这个小蛤蟆……实在是长得太丑了，若是收留在俺这黑风山只怕是有损本王的脸面，以后其余妖山的妖怪定会以此为笑柄。”
就在莫凡满脸期待之际，妖王却是说出了一番令他深受打击的话来。
特么的，自己就像个大黑炭，还他娘的好意思说我丑？
到底有没有一点逼数？
莫凡心中顿生怨念，却也不敢真个说出口，只得满心忐忑地等待着妖王最后的宣判。
“不过本王早就立下过规矩，只要是俺黑风山地界野兽化妖的，皆可加入我黑风山。
既然是本王自己立下的规矩，倒也不能轻易改变，此事倒是有些难为本王了。”
妖王眉头微蹙，铜铃般的黑眼珠转了转，看向下方三位将军，笑道：“这样吧，三位将军可有愿意收留这丑东西的？”
此话一出，下方坐于石案后方的三位妖将皆相视一眼，接着那一袭白袍的壮汉便咧嘴笑道：“俺麾下的小妖皆是身强力壮的，这小蛤蟆矮小得宛如一侏儒，俺指定是不愿要的。”
“连老白都不要，俺肯定也是不要的。”一袭黄袍的将军也摇了摇头。
接着众妖便看向了那红袍将军，就连妖王也开口道：“毒牙，众将军里似乎只有你麾下的小妖个头上要小一些，你可愿意收下这蛤蟆妖？”
“大王，这丑东西刚射伤了俺麾下白毛，若不是看在大王您的面子上，俺直接就一口吞了他，哪里还会收留他？”名为毒牙的红袍妖将当即淡淡开口。
听到毒牙的这番话，莫凡心中却是寒意顿生，同时也为自己的遭遇感到悲哀。
好不容易化妖了，千里迢迢来到这妖怪山，结果却没有一个大妖怪愿意收下他，这叫个什么事儿？
难道我莫凡注定要做一辈子的小妖怪？
他很清楚若是入不了这妖山，那自己就无法得到妖怪真正的修炼之法，自然也就难以继续修炼下去。
虽然灵药也可提升化妖进程，但过去两个月都未曾找到一株灵药，可见这条路也不是那么好走的。

“这……”
见三位将军都不愿要这蛤蟆妖，妖王也无奈一摇头，冲莫凡道：“小蛤蟆，你也看到了，既然三位将军都不愿要你，那本王这黑风山自然没有你的落脚之地，所以待会儿你还是哪里来的，回哪里去吧！”
“大王，既然俺黑风山无这丑东西的落脚之地，那他便当属野妖范畴，如此说来之前射伤俺麾下白毛小妖之事倒是可以算一算了。”
就在莫凡心灰意冷之际，红袍毒牙却是开口了，咧嘴笑道：“既然是野妖，又曾伤了俺麾下的白毛，所以俺建议直接将这上不得台面的丑东西给活剐了，做成一顿席面，也可用来下酒，岂不快哉？”
此话一出，莫凡整个人都惊悚了，浑身汗毛炸立！
这妖怪，居然想要吃他！
“这……”
妖王听闻毒牙的话也是一愣，似乎觉得有些不太好，但好像又很有道理，令他一时间无从反驳。
莫凡见此心都凉了半截，连忙开口道：“妖王爷爷，俺本体是只癞蛤蟆，为五毒之一，浑身都是毒腺，吃不得的，肉也苦！”
“还有毒？”
妖王听到这话浓眉顿时一竖，看向莫凡，有些恼怒道：“你说你这蛤蟆妖有啥意思？长得丑就算了，还吃不得，要你何用？！”
“大王，癞蛤蟆虽然有毒，但其毒腺基本上都在那张皮上，只要剐去那张皮，还是能够下肚的。”
content_en:
Not only Mo Fan, but other monsters were also looking at the black whirlwind-like Demon King at the head, wanting to know what kind of opportunity he would give to the toad.
There was a trace of surprise in the eyes of the red-robed monster and the other three generals. They had never thought that the king would be so generous today. It must have something to do with the human beauty he presented before, or maybe he was in high spirits.
As for the other little demons in the cave, they are quite envious of the three Mo Fan demons. You must know that they were not treated so well when they first came up the mountain.
"As for this little toad...it's really ugly. If you keep it here in Black Wind Mountain, I'm afraid it will bring disgrace to my king. The monsters in other monster mountains will definitely use it as a laughing stock in the future."
Just when Mo Fan was looking forward to it, the Demon King said something that shocked him deeply.
What the hell, I’m like a big black coal, and you have the fucking nerve to call me ugly?
Is there any point in it?
Mo Fan suddenly felt resentment in his heart, but he didn't dare to say it out loud. He could only wait anxiously for the Demon King's final verdict.
“However, I have already established a rule that anyone who is a beast in the Black Wind Mountain realm can join me in the Black Wind Mountain.
Since it is a rule set by this king himself, it cannot be changed easily. This matter is somewhat difficult for this king. "
The demon king frowned slightly, rolled his black bell-like eyes, looked at the three generals below, and said with a smile: "Well, are any of the three generals willing to take in this ugly thing?"
As soon as these words came out, the three demon generals sitting behind the stone table looked at each other, and then the strong man in white robe grinned and said: "The little demons under my command are all strong. This little toad is as short as a dwarf. I definitely don't want it."
"You don't even want Lao Bai, I definitely don't want him either." The general in yellow robes also shook his head.
Then all the demons looked at the red-robed general, and even the demon king said: "Fang, it seems that only the little demon under your command is smaller among the generals. Are you willing to accept this toad demon?"
"Your Majesty, this ugly thing just shot and wounded my subordinate Bai Mao. If I hadn't just eaten him in one gulp for your sake, Your Majesty, how could I have taken him in?" The red-robed demon general named Venomous Fang immediately said calmly.
Hearing Fan Ya's words, Mo Fan felt chilled in his heart, and at the same time he felt sad for his own experience.
After finally transforming into a monster, he traveled thousands of miles to this monster mountain, but in the end, no big monster was willing to accept him. What's this?
Am I, Mo Fan, destined to be a little monster for the rest of my life?
He knew very well that if he could not enter this monster mountain, then he would not be able to obtain the true method of cultivating monsters, and naturally it would be difficult to continue practicing.
Although elixirs can also improve the process of transforming into demons, they have not found a single elixir in the past two months, which shows that this road is not that easy.
"This..."
Seeing that the three generals were unwilling to have this toad demon, the Demon King helplessly shook his head and said to Mo Fan: "Little toad, you have also seen that since the three generals are unwilling to have you, then naturally there is no place for you in this Black Wind Mountain, so go back to where you came from later!"
"Your Majesty, since there is no place for such an ugly thing in our Black Wind Mountain, he must be classified as a wild monster. In this case, the incident of shooting and injuring the little white-haired monster under my command can be forgotten."
Just when Mo Fan was disheartened, Red-robed Venomous Fang spoke up and said with a grin: "Since it is a wild monster and it has hurt my subordinate's white hair, I suggest that this ugly thing that is not worthy of being on the table be chopped alive and made into a meal, which can also be used to drink wine. Wouldn't it be fun?"
As soon as these words came out, Mo Fan was shocked and the hair on his body stood up!
This monster actually wants to eat him!
"This..."
The Demon King was also stunned when he heard Fengyang's words. He seemed to feel that something was not good, but it seemed to make sense, and he was unable to refute it for a while..
Mo Fan's heart froze when he saw this, and he quickly said: "Grandpa Demon King, I am a toad, one of the five poisons. My whole body is full of poison glands. I can't eat it, and the flesh is also bitter!"
"Still poisonous?"
The demon king suddenly raised his thick eyebrows when he heard this, looked at Mo Fan, and said angrily: "What do you mean by you, a toad demon? Even if you are ugly, you can't eat it, so what use do you have?!"
"Your Majesty, although toads are poisonous, their poison glands are basically on the skin. As long as the skin is cut off, it can still be eaten."
